The engine has visible components: alternator, water pump, fan, intake manifold, and various hoses and connectors.
The engine block appears to be metallic with some grime and wear; no visible damage or cracks.
No visible branding or model number on the engine block or components in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'tokunbo' (imported used) engine for a Nissan Navara, working perfectly.
The photos show the engine from different angles: front, top, and side views.
No signs of recent use or testing; no running or smoke in any photo.
